auditVerdict: PASS FOR USER REVIEW — Sprint S15 PWA Manifest, Scoped Service Worker, and Deferred Install Prompt (Homepage + Top 5 Tools across EN, ES, DA) completed. Future expansion into non-Latin locales would require custom embedded TTF fonts.

currentSprint.progress: Sprint S15 100% completed: Implemented Progressive Web App (PWA) manifest, scoped service worker (ac-pwa-v1), and non-intrusive deferred install prompt across homepage and top 5 tools in EN, ES, DA (18 pages total). 1) Created standards-compliant W3C Web App Manifest (manifest.webmanifest) with theme_color #B04A45, background_color #F7F6F3, start_url /?source=pwa, and 192x192 & 512x512 icons (assets/img/icon-192.png, assets/img/icon-512.png). 2) Injected <meta name="theme-color" content="#B04A45"> and <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest"> across index.html and top 5 tools (JSON Formatter, Percentage Calculator, Age Calculator, Loan Calculator, IP Address Lookup) across all locales. 3) Built scoped Service Worker (sw.js) with versioned cache ac-pwa-v1 pre-caching homepage, top 5 tools, and essential static assets. Enforced Network-First strategy for HTML navigation (zero stale HTML risk) and Stale-While-Revalidate for same-origin static assets. Strictly excluded Google AdSense, Google Analytics, and external APIs from caching. 4) Built deferred install prompt manager (assets/js/shared/pwa.js) that intercepts beforeinstallprompt with preventDefault(), avoids any first-load interruption, contextually triggers after tool interaction or calculation, enforces 14-day dismissal suppression via localStorage['ac:pwa-dismissed-ts'], and provides WCAG 2.2 AA compliant focus-visible states (2px solid #B04A45, 2px offset). 5) Integrated telemetry in assets/js/shared/analytics.js for pwa_prompt_shown, pwa_installed, pwa_dismissed. Built tests/test_s15_pwa_install.js (23/23 passing). All 30 master repository test suites passed (30/30 PASS, 100%), including 21/21 Playwright visual regression snapshots. Sitemap synchronized (441 URLs), ADR-054 recorded in .ai-memory/DECISIONS.md, and G1-G15 release gate evidence prepended to docs/growth/91-TEST-EVIDENCE-AND-RELEASE-GATES.md.
